what-did-that-message-mean.name: What Did That Message Mean
what-did-that-message-mean.question: He messaged me out of nowhere. What did that actually mean?
what-did-that-message-mean.shape: The message first, then the week behind it, then its price and its use, then the part of the meaning she supplied — and only after those five can the reply and the cost of a year of them be named.

positions.name: What actually landed
positions.job: What actually arrived. The message itself, stripped of the week she has spent reading it

positions.name: What moved on his side first
positions.job: What had already moved on his side before he sent it. Not her, and not a decision — the thing that shifted first

positions.name: What it cost him to send
positions.job: What sending it cost him. The effort actually spent on it — not what it meant to her, what it took from him

positions.name: What it keeps in play
positions.job: What the message keeps open for him. The thing he can still have without having to ask for it

positions.name: What you filled in
positions.job: The gap between what he sent and what she has been carrying since. The part of the meaning she supplied

positions.name: What answering sets up
positions.job: The reply that is actually hers to make, and what each size of it sets up. Not whether to answer — what answering commits

positions.name: What a year of these takes
positions.job: What a year of messages this size costs her. The specific thing it takes, not the general ache

he-came-back-after-all-this-time.name: He Came Back After All This Time
he-came-back-after-all-this-time.question: He came back after all this time. What is he here for?
he-came-back-after-all-this-time.shape: Five findings about the return — what resumed, why now, what it does for him, which woman he thinks he is talking to, and the years he is skipping — and only then the thing she has not said and what his terms cost.

positions.name: What's started again
positions.job: What has actually started again between them, and what has not come back with him

positions.name: What ran out on his side
positions.job: What ran out on his side just before he came back. Not a realisation — the thing that ended

positions.name: What having you back solves for him
positions.job: What having her back solves for him. The problem in his own week that she fixes by existing

positions.name: The woman he thinks he's talking to
positions.job: Which version of her he is talking to. The woman from then, and where the two stop matching

positions.name: The years nobody has accounted for
positions.job: The years in between, and what he is asking her to leave unaccounted for. The specific thing never explained

positions.name: What you haven't said out loud
positions.job: The thing she has not said out loud about those years, and what saying it would cost her

positions.name: What his terms cost you
positions.job: What taking him back on his terms costs her across the next stretch of it. The price paid in her ordinary week

hes-gone-quiet.name: He's Gone Quiet
hes-gone-quiet.question: He's gone quiet on me. What is actually going on?
hes-gone-quiet.shape: Five findings before the end she controls — how long it has run, the week before it, what it keeps for him, the sentence he cannot send, and what the waiting has become — then her limit, then what another stretch takes.

positions.name: How long it's really been
positions.job: The plain shape of the silence. What stopped, what did not stop, and how long it has actually run

positions.name: The week before he stopped
positions.job: What landed on his side in the days before he stopped. Not a row — the thing he could not answer

positions.name: What the quiet lets him keep
positions.job: What the quiet keeps available to him. The version of himself that stays true as long as nothing is said

positions.name: The sentence he can't start
positions.job: The first sentence he would have to send to end it, and why that is the one he cannot start

positions.name: What the waiting has become
positions.job: What the waiting has turned into a habit for her. The checking, and what it has replaced in her day

positions.name: Your end of the silence
positions.job: Her own end of the silence, and the terms that are hers to set. Not a message to him — a limit

positions.name: What another stretch takes
positions.job: What another stretch of this takes from her. The specific thing lost, not the general wearing down

whats-coming-in-the-next-seven-days.name: What's Coming In The Next Seven Days
whats-coming-in-the-next-seven-days.question: What's coming in the next seven days?
whats-coming-in-the-next-seven-days.shape: A week is not a list of dates — it is one thing already moving, where it came from, the form it takes when it surfaces, the loud thing that is not hers, what it asks of her, and what waiting it out takes; that is the six.

positions.name: What's already moving
positions.job: What is already in motion. The thing that started before this morning and is still moving, not something due to arrive

positions.name: Where it really started
positions.job: Where the thing in motion actually began. Further back than this week, and not where she has been dating it from

positions.name: How it shows up
positions.job: The small ordinary form it takes when it reaches the surface. What it will look like, not when it lands

positions.name: The loud one that isn't yours
positions.job: The loud thing she is braced for, and whose problem it actually is. The one not hers to handle this week

positions.name: What the week asks of you
positions.job: The one thing the week asks of her, and what it costs. An act she can start, not a decision to wait for

positions.name: What waiting it out takes
positions.job: What a week spent waiting for the other thing takes from her. What she does not get back

on-and-off.name: On And Off
on-and-off.question: He goes, then he comes back, then he goes. Why does this keep going round?
on-and-off.shape: One full lap first, then what switches it, what each of them gets out of it, and the half she runs — and only then what ends a lap and what one more costs.

positions.name: One full lap
positions.job: The loop as one thing. What a full lap contains, and how many times it has already gone round

positions.name: What switches it back on
positions.job: What has been true on his side every time it switched back on. The condition that was already there, never a next time

positions.name: What going gets him
positions.job: What going gets him that staying would not. What the off stretch protects, in his life, not in hers

positions.name: What the loop pays you
positions.job: What the loop pays her. What the good stretch gives, and what the empty one spares her having to decide

positions.name: The half you run
positions.job: The half of it she runs. What she does, every lap, that keeps her end of the loop open

positions.name: What ends a lap early
positions.job: The one thing that ends a lap early, and what doing it costs her. An act, not a rule she sets herself

positions.name: What the next lap takes
positions.job: What one more lap takes from her. The thing that does not come back on the next good stretch

will-he-come-back.name: Will He Come Back
will-he-come-back.question: Will he come back?
will-he-come-back.shape: Nobody puts a month on another man's decision, so the seven read her side of it — what still stands, what she is still doing, what he gets for it, what a return would cost him, what she would actually be getting back, and only then what is hers either way and what being available has already taken.

positions.name: What's still standing
positions.job: What is still standing between them. What has not been taken down, and what already has

positions.name: What you're still doing for him
positions.job: The specific thing she still does that leaves the way back clear for him. One act, repeated, not a feeling

positions.name: What he gets for nothing
positions.job: What he gets from her while nothing is settled. The standing offer he has not had to accept or turn down

positions.name: What coming back would cost him
positions.job: What coming back would cost him. The thing he would have to give up or say first — not whether he pays it

positions.name: What you'd actually be getting back
positions.job: What she would actually be getting back. Which version of him, and which version of the arrangement that ended

positions.name: The one that's yours either way
positions.job: The one thing that is hers whichever way he goes, and what it costs her. An act, not a decision about him

positions.name: What being available has cost
positions.job: What keeping herself available has already taken from her, and what it takes next. A count, not a warning
